description: The first step in creating jobs and continuing economic growth is to get a clear picture of our recent economic history, so that we will not repeat the mistakes that lead to the financial crisis. The financial crisis of 2008 cost our economy 8 million jobs and cost American families more than $16 trillion dollars […]
